parameters.jsCode:
const review =
  $('Check Review Status').first().json;

const decision =
  $('Get Decision Record').first().json;

const caseRow =
  $('Get Case Record').first().json;

return [
  {
    json: {
      review_id:
        review.review_id,

      case_run_id:
        review.case_run_id,

      requested_at:
        review.requested_at,

      review_queue:
        review.review_queue,

      review_status:
        review.review_status,

      agent_recommendation:
        review.agent_recommendation,

      submission_version:
        Number(
          decision.submission_version || 1
        ),

      original_decision_id:
        decision.decision_id,

      original_outcome:
        decision.outcome,

      original_primary_reason_code:
        decision.primary_reason_code,

      original_secondary_reason_codes:
        decision.secondary_reason_codes || '',

      original_target_queue:
        decision.target_queue,

      original_next_action:
        decision.next_action,

      original_customer_safe_summary:
        decision.customer_safe_summary,

      original_missing_information:
        decision.missing_information || '',

      original_conflicts:
        decision.conflicts || '',

      original_internal_summary:
        decision.internal_summary || '',

      original_communication_template_id:
        decision.communication_template_id || '',

      original_decision_created_at:
        decision.created_at,

      business_name:
        caseRow.Business_Name_Submitted,

      business_identifier:
        caseRow.Business_Identifier_Submitted,

      customer_id:
        caseRow.Customer_ID,

      representative_name:
        caseRow.Representative_Name,

      representative_role:
        caseRow.Representative_Role,

      requested_authority:
        caseRow.Requested_Authority,

      request_narrative:
        caseRow.Customer_Request_Narrative,

      country:
        caseRow.Country,

      prototype_data:
        true,
    },
  },
];

parameters.jsCode:
const result =
  $('Build Human Review Communication').first().json;

const outcome =
  String(result.final_outcome).toUpperCase();

const statusMap = {
  APPROVE: 'READY_TO_PROCEED',
  NEED_MORE_INFORMATION: 'WAITING_FOR_INFORMATION',
  REJECT: 'REJECTED_CONFIRMED',
};

return [
  {
    json: {
      case_run_id:
        result.case_run_id,

      case_id:
        result.case_run_id,

      submission_version:
        Number(result.submission_version),

      country:
        result.country,

      request_type:
        'NEW_AUTHORISED_REPRESENTATIVE',

      business_name:
        result.business_name,

      business_identifier:
        result.business_identifier,

      customer_id:
        result.customer_id,

      representative_name:
        result.representative_name,

      status:
        statusMap[outcome] || 'REVIEW_COMPLETE',

      current_stage:
        'HUMAN_REVIEW_COMPLETE',

      final_outcome:
        outcome,

      primary_reason_code:
        result.original_primary_reason_code,

      target_queue:
        result.final_target_queue,

      human_review_required:
        false,

      updated_at:
        new Date().toISOString(),

      execution_id:
        $execution.id,

      synthetic_only:
        true,
    },
  },
];
